mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN agent_runs r ON j.kind='generate' AND r.id=j.reference_id LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE ((j.state='pending' AND j.available_at<=#{timestamp}) OR (j.state='running' AND j.locked_until<#{leaseExpiredBefore})) AND (j.kind<>'product_detail' OR ( SELECT count(*) FROM jobs active WHERE active.shop_id=j.shop_id AND active.kind='product_detail' AND active.state='running' AND active.locked_until>=#{timestamp}) < 2) AND (j.kind<>'generate' OR ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs a JOIN agent_runs ar ON ar.id=a.reference_id JOIN messages am ON am.id=ar.message_id WHERE a.kind='generate' AND a.state='running' AND a.locked_until>=#{timestamp} AND a.id<>j.id AND am.conversation_id=m.conversation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM send_command_context sc WHERE sc.conversation_id=m.conversation_id AND sc.state IN ('approved','sending','send_unknown')))) ORDER BY CASE j.kind WHEN 'send' THEN 0 WHEN 'generate' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,j.available_at LIMIT 32
SELECT m.conversation_id FROM agent_runs r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE r.id=#{run}
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=#{conversationId} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE state=#{state}

SELECT j.id,j.available_at FROM jobs j WHERE ((j.state='pending' AND j.available_at<=#{now}) OR (j.state='running' AND j.locked_until<#{now})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_outbox o WHERE o.job_id=j.id AND o.state IN ('pending','publishing')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_outbox o WHERE o.job_id=j.id AND o.state='published' AND o.published_at>=#{publicationCooldown}) ORDER BY j.available_at,j.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
SELECT count(*) FROM send_command_context WHERE conversation_id=#{conversation} AND state IN ('approved','sending','send_unknown')
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='done',locked_until=0 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE agent_runs SET state='superseded' WHERE id=#{run}
UPDATE send_commands SET state='sending',updated_at=#{timestamp} WHERE id=#{referenceId} AND state='approved'
UPDATE drafts SET state='sending' WHERE id IN (SELECT draft_id FROM send_commands WHERE id=#{referenceId}) AND state='approved'
UPDATE agent_runs SET state='running' WHERE id=#{referenceId} AND state='queued'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='done',locked_until=0 WHERE id=#{jobId} AND claim_id=#{claimId}
UPDATE jobs SET state=#{availableAt},available_at=#{timestamp},locked_until=0 WHERE id=#{jobId} AND claim_id=#{claimId}
UPDATE agent_runs SET state='generation_failed' WHERE id=#{reference}
UPDATE messages SET state='generation_failed' WHERE id IN (SELECT message_id FROM agent_runs WHERE id=#{reference})
